claim_scope: Candidate C9a: receipt admission for the ASSET_TRANSFER allocation fragment. verify_asset_transfer_fragment_receipt_v1 admits a fragment only through the receipt-verified module witness (VerifiedLaneModuleTransitionV1, mintable only by verify_asset_transfer_lane_module_receipt_v1 after a succinct-receipt check against the recomputed module journal under an ACTIVE_NEW release image): one journal-root equality binds the caller's accepted value to the proof, statement-root and command-occurrence checks double-bind defensively, the wave-B producer re-runs with its full closed check family, the produced binding_root must equal the witness-bound receipt root, and the result is the token-gated immutable VerifiedLaneAllocationFragmentV1. Closed five-code ReceiptWitnessRejectCodeV1 family plus untouched producer pass-through; every reject is a value. The accept-path test mints a REAL witness through the ABI fixture chain (no forgery on the accept path); the certificate registry still keeps ASSET_TRANSFER at NO_PRODUCER, so no acceptance path consumes this witness until C9b lands the registry flip behind a type gate. Research-only; grants no authority.
failure_modes: a caller-forged accepted value reaches the fragment without a receipt-verified journal
a fragment binds a receipt root the witness never certified
the witness type gate is bypassed by a structurally similar object
a witness reject mutates an input or leaks an exception

aaa.reason: Each test arranges one witness/accepted pair through the real ABI fixture chain, invokes the verifier once, and asserts the exact type, code, detail, and carried binding scalars.

reject_is_noop.reason: The verifier is a pure function over immutable inputs; the no-op test asserts the journal root and witness scalars are unchanged after a rejected admission.

boundary_dimensions.name: witness_binding
points: foreign accepted rejects at the journal root
forged statement root rejects behind the journal binding

boundary_dimensions.name: reject_family
points: exact five closed witness codes in check order

mutations.description: admit a fragment from a caller-forged accepted value (foreign journal)
construct the fragment witness outside the verifier
pass a non-witness object through the type gate
vary the statement root while keeping the journal (object.__new__ forgery)
swallow or transform a producer reject
grow or reorder the witness reject family
mutate an input on a rejected admission

nonclaims: The certificate registry keeps ASSET_TRANSFER at NO_PRODUCER; no acceptance path consumes the fragment witness until C9b lands the registry flip behind a type gate.
The module witness's succinct-receipt check is inherited from lane_module_receipt_verification_v1; this candidate adds no cryptographic claims of its own.
No production, release, settlement, verifier, migration, publication, or value-moving authority is granted.
